# Carried findings — plan of action

© 2026 Casey Houle. All rights reserved.

Findings with no available remediation, in the form of a plan-of-action record:
owner, milestone, dates, and an append-only status history. A carried finding
past its review-by date, or whose upstream fix has since become available, blocks.

Schema: carried-findings/1.

| id | component | version | severity | reason_no_fix | owner | milestone | milestone_date | review_by | status | status_history | side |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
